notes: robots.txt 200, permissive (Allow: /, sitemaps listed). Tried Yoast post sitemaps (179 chunks at /post-sitemapN.xml) but per grid convention their lastmod is edit time, so rejected. Chose WP REST API instead: /wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=100&_fields=date,link&after=2026-09-25T00:00:00&before=2026-10-25T23:59:59&page=N (all responses 200; 13 pages, ~70s). REST 'date' (site-local, no offset) equals page JSON-LD datePublished (+00:00) to the second, verified on 4 re-fetched articles (also the first 3 latest posts). Output: 1285 unique URLs, 31/31 days, min 16 (2026-10-12), check days 09-30=73, 10-10=23, 10-20=46. Sample articles all give 10k+ text chars and exact page dates.
